card.name: Inside rare names and number words
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long rare words, mainly the 'illion' in sextillion and quadrillion and the 'ux' in antibody names like Unituxin, cetuximab and brentuximab.

modes.label: Huge number words
modes.description: The 'illion' ending of very large number words like sextillion or quadrillion.
modes.example: nearly 10 sext<<illion>> times brighter than the sun

modes.label: Antibody drug names
modes.description: The 'ux' piece inside names of monoclonal antibodies such as Unituxin, cetuximab and brentuximab.
modes.example: Monitor serum electrolytes daily during therapy with Unit<<ux>>in.

modes.label: Surnames in citations
modes.description: A middle piece of a long Slavic surname in a reference list.
modes.example: Galkin DV, Petrotchen<<k>>ova NA, Demin AA
